from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            border = {(y, x) for y in range(top, bottom + 1) for x in range(left, right + 1)
                      if y in (top, bottom) or x in (left, right)}
            if set(cells) != border or bottom - top < 2 or right - left < 2:
                continue
            interior = [(y, x) for y in range(top + 1, bottom) for x in range(left + 1, right)]
            if any(grid[y][x] != background for y, x in interior):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (bottom - top - 1) % 2 else 2
            for y, x in interior:
                out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
